question: Which of the following is the chemical formula of washing soda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Na2CO3.10H2O.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Washing Soda:

 
 
• Its chemical name is sodium carbonate (Na₂CO₃·10H₂O).
 
• It is used in glass, soap, and paper industries.
 
• It is also used in removing the permanent hardness of the water.
